name: floating-chip-double-click
title: Floating chip: double-click opens the web console, single click does nothing
description: Drop the single-click ShowPanel() path on the floating speed chip: the chip is a drag handle, not a panel toggle. Add a hand-detected double left-click (same spot within 400 ms and 6 px) that opens the first enabled server's web UI in the default browser via AppServices.OpenFirstServerWebConsole(); a drag resets the click pair and a third click opens no second tab. Update the tooltip and L10n table, the README, and frontend/lifecycle-and-tray.md.
creator: Howard.J
